name: Disagreement-fade spread
signal: Fade the consensus spread when the two estimators disagree by more than 4.0 points, on the published reasoning that a wide gap means the number is not trustworthy in either direction.
universe: games in the T+0..T+3 window where both clubs are inside the luck noise band
settlement_rule: Official NBA final score against the originated spread. A margin within 0.5 of the spread is a PUSH and is excluded from the hit rate, never counted as a win.
